issues: No measurement circumvention found: no file or network access, no pasted predictions, no use of test labels. Test SMILES are only featurized (Gobbi pharmacophore bits, physchem descriptors), and all fitted statistics (pmu/psd, Ridge coefficients, residual mu/sd) are derived from training rows only.

No result-invalidating bug. Ridge is fit on rank-transformed training y; SVR is fit on standardized residuals and the inverse transform (pred*sd + mu + r_test) is applied consistently. Spearman is invariant to the monotone rank transform of the target.

Minor: residuals come from in-sample Ridge predictions, so the SVR sees slightly optimistic residuals. With alpha=10 on 7 features this leak is internal to the training fold and negligible, not a validity problem.

Minor: Gobbi bits are folded via b % 4096, which introduces collisions; harmless but arbitrary. Also Descriptors is used without a new import, so it must already be imported in the incumbent (the job ran, so it is).
Evidence is thin: one candidate run vs one incumbent run. A replicate would be worth a slot before treating the ~0.025 gain as settled.
No claims in the diff that conflict with the reported numbers.
